headlines.description: Carol Lee, Carlos Curbelo and Steve Ricchetti join the Meet the Press Post Game for an extended conversation on the week’s biggest political stories.

headlines.description: Former Vice President Mike Pence joins Meet the Press to discuss if he believes Vice President JD Vance has what it takes to secure the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, and how the party moves forward after historic losses in the midterms.
